authorship_approval.close_when: Final C2 author list/order and corresponding-author responsibility are explicitly approved.

outside_reader.release_rule: score >= 9 and figure-logic pass => local edits only; score 7-8 => revise weakest section; score <= 6 or figure-logic fail => no dispatch

dispatch_time_route_recheck.rule: Recheck the live TREE/Cell Press/Elsevier proposal route immediately before actual dispatch.

send_rule: Do not send unless every required gate has closed=true. Closing a gate must record the human evidence; do not infer closure from repository activity or elapsed time.
stop_rule: Do not reopen Boundary/CED/MROD/REC/TNOA/V3 science to close a C2 dispatch gate.
